title: Pilgrims and tourneys in the Crown
changes: The Lists stand again on the Tourney Grounds: a viewing stand under striped cloth and a tilt barrier in the heralds' colours, with a quintain at its end. You can't walk through the stand or the barrier, but the riders' lane between them is open.
The heralds' houses have pitched their pavilions round Tollcross Square. A candle shrine with pilgrims' staves stands in the north-west corner, and there is a quintain on the south side.
Pilgrims have tied ribbons to posts along the Greenward road through the Pilgrims' Way.
Herald-Marshal Ysmay Corrant has new things to say about the pilgrims and the tourney.
